summary: Required status checks and branch protection controls are documented for main. This evidence remains an Exception because this PR cannot verify or mutate repository ruleset/branch protection UI state through the available connector action. Enterprise release validation fails while this status is Exception or Open.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.

direct_push_to_main_risk.risk: Direct pushes to main bypass normal PR review evidence and can trigger production/release workflows before the enterprise approval record is complete.
direct_push_to_main_risk.required_response: Treat any direct push to main as a release governance exception. Do not promote the commit until branch protection evidence is Complete and Full Security Suite / Enterprise merge/deploy gate is green for the exact commit.

required_status_checks: Full Security Suite / Core CI, build and npm audit
Full Security Suite / Enterprise merge/deploy gate
RISCK COMPLY Security CI / Run security gates, typecheck and tests
Gitleaks / Scan repository for accidental secret exposure
Secret Scanning / Production secret readiness gate

exception.rationale: Repository policy evidence is committed, but GitHub branch protection/ruleset configuration must be verified by an administrator before this evidence can be marked Complete. The available connector did not expose a branch-protection mutation or verification action for rulesets.
compensatingControls: Do not promote an enterprise release unless branch protection evidence is Complete and the enterprise release validation command passes for the exact commit.
Keep docs/security/BRANCH_PROTECTION_REQUIRED_RULES.md aligned with required GitHub status checks.
Run .github/workflows/p0-branch-protection-evidence.yml after branch protection is configured and review the generated artifact.
For enterprise release validation, scripts/security/check-branch-protection-evidence.mjs fails while this evidence is Exception or Open.
exception.approvalReference: P0 branch protection required checks rollout

verification_note: Settings → Rulesets/Branches → main must be configured to match this evidence before release promotion. Do not mark this evidence Complete without API-generated or screenshot-backed proof that each required check is configured.
